newsitem.title: SLOVENIA: Slovenian shares slip, further declines seen.
newsitem.headline: Slovenian shares slip, further declines seen.

text.p: Slovenian shares fell 0.96 percent on Thursday, pushed down by a fall in ordinary shares of Dolenjska Bank, and traders said the downward trend was likely to continue as long as foreigners stayed away.
"The situation on the market is not rosy at all, and the current political climate does not indicate that foreigners will come back soon," said Andrej Ciuha, a trader at brokerage Inter Timex.

Traders parliament's ratification of an association accord with the EU should stimulate trade in the long run. The ratification was postponed from Wednesday to next week to allow political parties more time to reach an agreement on the issue.
* The SBI index fell 12.64 points to 1,306.32.
* Ordinary shares of Dolenjska bank were the most actively traded issue, falling 2.52 percent to 15,500 tolars on volume of 2,269 shares. -- Ljubljana newsroom, 386-61-125-8439
